# The invoice, attached to the CAD payment that settles it.
#
# The payment converts the invoice's 100.00 USD at its own rate, against the
# 1.40 the invoice was posted at, so it consumes the invoice's cost basis and
# the difference goes to `Income:FX Gain $residual$ CAD` (Q-054).
2026-01-01 open Income:FX Gain
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

invoice "INV-FX-CAD-BANK"
	customer_id: "C-FX"
	currency: USD
	date_opened: 2026-01-05
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-05
		description: "Consulting"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-01-05
		due: 2026-02-05
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable USD"
		memo: "Invoice INV-FX-CAD-BANK"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		date: 2026-02-25
		amount: 100
		bank_account: "Assets:Bank"
		txn_guid: "TXN_GUID"
		memo: "Payment for INV-FX-CAD-BANK"
		Income:FX Gain $residual$ CAD
